edges.contract: Canonical assessment/action projection; acceptable defaults and schema/role consistency
Scoped mandate, semantic maintenance requests, effects and replay receipts
Objective-scoped delegation, executor assignment and immutable delivery semantics
Executed current evidence for ordinary journeys

enforcement: These are explicit handoff contracts, not fabricated local task edges. The receiving owner checks producer commit/test evidence before accepting completion. One shared coordinator can serialize across both local lanes. Final qualification must verify all scenario evidence; a local epic closing is not overall release acceptance.
